name: hule
title: Hule
description: Create, find and update Hule tasks without leaving your keyboard.
author: tony_hule

commands.name: quick-add-task
commands.title: Quick Add Task
commands.subtitle: Hule
commands.description: Create a task from a single line, straight into your default list.

commands.name: create-task
commands.title: Create Task
commands.subtitle: Hule
commands.description: Create a task with a list, description, priority, due date and assignee.

commands.name: search-tasks
commands.title: Search Tasks
commands.subtitle: Hule
commands.description: Search tasks across a workspace and act on the results.

commands.name: my-tasks
commands.title: My Tasks
commands.subtitle: Hule
commands.description: Tasks assigned to you, grouped by when they are due.

preferences.name: token
preferences.title: Personal API Token
preferences.description: A hule_pat_… token from Settings → API tokens in Hule.

preferences.name: apiUrl
preferences.title: API URL
preferences.description: Only change this if you run a self-hosted Hule.

preferences.name: defaultList
preferences.title: Default List
preferences.description: List name that Quick Add Task writes to. Leave empty to use your first list.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
